about.title: One ecosystem to listen, support and act.
about.lead: SafeSpace brings together the tools people and teams need to care for workplace wellbeing in one place.
about.body: From daily mood check-ins and surveys to reports, a general-guidance chat and the HR view, everything connects to make conversations about wellbeing clearer.

member01.name: Milenko Rubén Cayanchi Ávila
member01.description: A proactive Software Engineering student committed to creating technology solutions that deliver value. His interest in software development and innovation drives him to keep learning and contribute to the future of technology applied to wellbeing.
member01.alt: Professional portrait of Milenko Rubén Cayanchi Ávila

member02.name: Alexther Kamil Díaz Martínez
member02.description: A sixth-semester Software Engineering student and Full Stack developer. He stands out for adaptability, collaboration and resilience, with experience across frontend, backend and databases, plus a strong interest in applying artificial intelligence to optimize processes.
member02.alt: Professional portrait of Alexther Kamil Díaz Martínez

member03.name: Mauricio Luis Pajés León
member03.description: A Software Engineering student focused on Backend development, API integration and reliable solutions. He works with TypeScript, Node.js, databases and event processing in AWS, while continuing to grow his knowledge of SQL and NoSQL architectures.
member03.alt: Professional portrait of Mauricio Luis Pajés León

member04.name: Diego Andrés Ávalos Córdova
member04.description: A Software Engineering student with experience as a junior developer at ISP Lima. He has knowledge of web development, GNU/Linux systems, Full Stack development, cybersecurity and ethical hacking, combined with a strong interest in artificial intelligence and technology research.
member04.alt: Professional portrait of Diego Andrés Ávalos Córdova

member05.name: José Gustavo Asto Jácome
member05.description: A Software Engineering student at UPC focused on Backend, Full Stack development and applied artificial intelligence. He has experience with Angular, Vue, Spring Boot, .NET, MySQL and Git, along with knowledge of software architecture and web application development.
member05.alt: Professional portrait of José Gustavo Asto Jácome

member06.name: Jean Niels Arizabal Condori
member06.description: A Software Engineering student at UPC interested in continuing to develop his skills in programming, teamwork and the creation of technology solutions. He contributes responsibly to SafeSpace and maintains a constant learning mindset throughout each stage of the project.
member06.alt: Professional portrait of Jean Niels Arizabal Condori
